caption:
Dhalai ke time shuttering ki tension khatam kijiye hamari light-weight PP shuttering sheet ke saath!

Ek aadmi aaram se sheet utha sakta hai, cutting aasan aur concrete finish ekdum smooth milti hai.
Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur har dhalai ka kharcha kam karti hai.
Raipur se Pan-India dispatch uplabdh hai. Apne thekedar doston ke saath share karein!
